agenda_items.title: ADJOURNMENT
agenda_items.outcome_summary: There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED on August 7, 2013 at 1:20 AM.

motions.motion_text: Council Member was moved, seconded by council Member Agosin to approve Johnson Agosin items 1A through 3K as amended.
motions.vote_text: The movement for item 1A, Council Member Wilson, absent on a full call vote at the 10/1/14.

motions.motion_text: Mayor Appelsbaum moved, seconded by Council Member Moore, to suspend the rules and continue the meeting.

Mayor Appelhann moved, seconded by Council Member Fless, to approve Ordinance No. 7917 finding that the conditions precedent to formation of an electric power and light utility of Charter Section 178(a) have been satisfied and setting forth related details and set place of the same on the July 22, 2015, to be acted on by Public Services, Inc. as amended in the City Attorney's Office with instruction for that reading to occur on August 20 on the Consent Agenda.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 62, Council Member Ageton and Karakchian opposed.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Coffermongel, seconded by Council Member Morzel, to approve Ordinance No. 7918 authorizing the acquisition of property interests owned by Public Service Company of Colorado d/b/a Xcel Energy by negotiation and purchase or through the power of attorney that is as amended in the packet.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 62 with Council Member Ageton and Karakchian opposed.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Swilles moved seconded by Council Member Morzal to approve Ordinance No. 7919, setting up a ballot title for an initiative referendum to the Boulder Charter is amended to strike the short ballot title and changing the Ordinance title to be consistent with the ballot question.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried with Council Member Wilson absent at 12:17 a.m.

motions.motion_text: Mayor Appelbaum moved, seconded by Council Member Morzel, to approve Ordinance No. 7920 submitting to the registered electors of the City of Boulder in the general municipal coordinated election to be held on Tuesday, November 5, 2013, an alternative ballot question amending the City Charter to address issues presented by the proposed limited Charter amendment that adds a new section .88 on limitations on receipt and use of debt as presented in addition to with the debt limit as indicated at $217,000,000.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 8-0 with Council Member Wilson absent.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Cowles moved, seconded by Mayor Appelbaum, to take up agenda item 8B while staff worked on incorporating the amendments to Ordinance No. 7920.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried. Abs. Council Member Wilson absent. at 12:31 a.m.

motions.motion_text: Mayor Appelbaum moved, seconded by Council Member Axton to ratify the Board Appointments to the Board of Zoning Adjustments (BOZA) and the Environmental Advisory Board.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 8/0 with Council Member Wilson absent. at 1:20 am.

motions.motion_text: There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED on August 7, 2013 at 1:20 AM.
